Coverage_Description: Annual scaling/polishing (1x/year); unlimited oral exam, dental consultation, intra-oral X-ray, emergency dressing/abscess drainage, office-hours emergency consultation, and pain/infection drug therapy; fillings, simple extraction, orthodontic/specialist/other treatments at preferential rates
pricing: HK$400 per person scheme fee; additional treatments at HKU preferential rates (e.g., filling HK$450-1,350, extraction HK$630-900, implant HK$18,000-27,000).
customer requirement: HKU student/staff/retiree applicants; submit application form with HKU staff/student card copy (retirees quote staff no.)
price structure: Flat per-person scheme fee paid in full regardless of join date; no refund for mid-year termination
additional informations: Voluntary enrollment; eligible persons can join anytime; service starts after confirmation
